messages:
ryan.kim: Heads up — Nimbus Health POC kickoff. They want to serve a fine-tuned clinical variant 'med-clarity-7b' (licensed) and evaluate Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Main asks: int4 quant, KV cache, KMS integration, HIPAA/PHI controls, target ~150ms p50 for ~512-token responses, and pricing for ~100k eval tokens/day. Sharing links: https://redwood.internal/poc/nimbus-health (internal)

liz.hart: looping in eng + legal. do we currently have med-clarity-7b in the catalog or a compatible variant? legal will need license copy.

samuel.choi: Not in catalog today. I can run a compatibility scan but need either model artifacts or a signed pointer from their vendor. Also need to validate int4 kernel support on our A100/A5000 fleet and KV cache behavior for long-context clinical notes.

ryan.kim: they provided a model tar + license link in the PRD doc. timeline: POC start next Wed, 2-week window. can we get scan + quick perf estimate by EOD tomorrow?

maria.gonzalez: For Private/VPC we need to pre-check KMS mapping and network egress. I'll draft a baseline SOW and rough pricing bands. Host pricing ballpark: hosted token pricing + dedicated reserve ranges.

samuel.choi: Starting scan now. I'll post raw output here.

deploy-bot: queued model-scan job #MS-9123 for med-clarity-7b

deploy-bot: running command: `model-scan --model med-clarity-7b --artifact s3://nimbus/med-clarity-7b.tar.gz --checks quant=int4,kvcache,kms`

security-bot: Note — Nimbus will handle PHI; require HIPAA BA and SOC2. Creating intake: SEC-4821 and adding standard HIPAA addendum template.

samuel.choi: scan done (summary): int4 quantization: compatible (requires calibration step). KV cache: works but large prefix reuse recommended for cost. KMS: integrates via kms-proxy; needs customer KMS ARN and key policy adjustment for Dedicated/Private. Perf quick-estimate on A100 80GB: p50 ~120ms @ batch=1 for 256 tokens, 512-token p50 estimated ~140–180ms depending on batching and kv-hit-rate. With batch=4 + kernel opt we can hit ~150ms p50.

samuel.choi: recommend catalog entry name `med-clarity-7b:v1-raft` and a canary rollout: 10% on Dedicated first, validate quality and latency. Also create quant profile `med-clarity-7b-int4` and KV cache TTL defaults to 6h for clinical PII minimization.

liz.hart: legal: do NOT onboard without signed license + redistribution terms. I'll ping legal to prioritize. Also need to confirm any export restrictions (medical model).

maria.gonzalez: pricing notes: quick draft — Hosted: $0.045 / 1k prompt tokens (placeholder), Dedicated: $9k/mo reserve for a 4xA100 pool + usage margin, Private/on-prem: one-time platform license + infra estimate. I'll put concrete numbers in a quote.

ryan.kim: great. Next steps / owners: 1) sam — push model-scan artifacts + onboarding checklist and open catalog PR (due EOD tomorrow). 2) maria — draft SOW + pricing quote. 3) liz — legal intake & confirm license. 4) security-bot — SEC-4821 intake. ryan will coordinate POC kickoff with customer.

samuel.choi: ACTION: opened GH PR #redwood/catalog-add-med-clarity-7b (draft) with quant profile and canary flags. attaching lightweight output: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/MS-9123/report.txt

liz.hart: legal intake submitted. 1 request: need the original vendor license and a list of third-party deps for SBOM.

ryan.kim: thanks all. aim to have a working canary for the customer demo next Tue. ping me if blockers — I'll start scheduling the kickoff call. :thumbsup:
